intent.rationale: casex lets x bits in irq_in match items; the selector value x matches the first item.

labels.note: casex with x-containing items makes X/Z bits of irq_in match as wildcards.
casex treats X/Z in irq_in as wildcards, so simulation with unknown inputs matches items that hardware would not; casez/priority logic is required.
